description.value:
You gain proficiency with every blaster that has the burst or rapid property but lacks the two-handed property. When a creature fails a save against the burst or rapid property of such a weapon you're wielding and proficient with, you can apply Sneak Attack damage to one creature it damaged, provided that creature didn't have advantage on its save.

Starting at 9th level in this class, when multiple creatures fail a save against the burst property of such a weapon, you can split your Sneak Attack dice among them however you like.
